fields.h1: Enjiri Ye Ki? Ennyinnyonnyola Ennyangu Etegeerekeka
fields.description: Ekigambo ‘enjiri’ kitegeeza ‘amawulire amalungi’ — naye amawulire amalungi agakwata ku ki? Wano enjiri y’Ekikristaayo ennyonnyolwa mu ngeri ennyangu: kye ki, lwaki nkulu, n’engeri y’okugyanukula.
fields.body_html:
Ekigambo “enjiri” amakulu gaakyo gali gamu: amawulire amalungi. Naye amawulire amalungi agakwata ku ki — era lwaki gakyusizza obulamu bw’abantu obukadde n’obukadde mu myaka enkumi bbiri? Buuza abantu kkumi Obukristaayo kye bukwatako, era emirundi mingi ojja kufuna eby’okuddamu kkumi ebyogera ku mateeka, ku kkanisa, oba ku kubeera omuntu omulungi. Kyokka enjiri entuufu, okusookera ddala, si ndagiriro n’akatono. Kirango — amawulire g’ekintu Katonda ky’akoze — era ddala ge mawulire agasinga obulungi omuntu g’ayinza okuwulira.

Wano enjiri y’Ekikristaayo ennyonnyolwa mu ngeri esinga obwangu: kye ki, lwaki nkulu, n’engeri y’okugyanukula.

Enjiri mu sentensi emu

Pawulo y’awa ennyinnyonnyola esinga okutegeerekeka mu Bayibuli: “Kristo yafa olw’ebibi byaffe, ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba, era nti yaziikibwa, n’azuukizibwa ku lunaku olwokusatu” (1 Abakkolinso 15:3-4). Ogwo gwe musingi gw’enjiri ogutasobola kukendeezebwako — ekintu ekyaliwo ddala, mu byafaayo: Yesu yafiira ebibi, n’aziikibwa, n’azuukira. Ebirala byonna binnyonnyola bunnyonnyozi ebigambo ebyo ebitono. Enjiri si magezi agatugamba kye tuteekwa okukola okutuuka eri Katonda; ge mawulire ga Katonda ky’amaze okukola okutuuka gye tuli.

Enjawulo eyo y’ensonga yonna, era y’efuula enjiri obutafaanana na ddiini yonna. Eddiini ekukwasa amadaala n’ekugamba nti linnya. Enjiri erangirira nti Katonda yakka wansi. Buli nkola endala, mu mutima gwayo, egamba nti kola — kola bino, kuuma amateeka gano, tuuka ku kigero kino, olwo oboolyawo Katonda anaakusembeza. Enjiri egamba nti kiwedde — ekyo ky’otosobolanga kukola kyakukolerwa, era ekisigaddewo kyokka kwe kukisembeza. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki ereetera omuntu ow’omutima ogukooye olw’omusango ekiwummulo ekinene bwe kityo: si kiragiro kirala kimu, wabula enkomerero y’ebiragiro byonna.

Lwaki twetaaga amawulire amalungi: amawulire amabi gasooka

Amawulire amalungi gategeerekeka bwe wabaawo ekizibu ekya ddala, era enjiri eyatula ekizibu kyaffe mu mazima. “Ffenna twayonoona era tetusaanira kitiibwa kya Katonda.” (Abaruumi 3:23). Si abo bokka abalabika nti babi ddala — wabula ffenna. Twatondebwa ku lwa Katonda, naye buli omu ku ffe yakyuka n’atandika okufuga obulamu bwe ku bubwe, era obujeemu obwo bulina empeera yaabwo: “Empeera y’ekibi kwe kufa” (Abaruumi 6:23). Tulina ebbanja eri Katonda omutukuvu lye tutasobola kusasula, era tewali bulungi bwonna bwe tuyinza kukola obuyinza okusazaamu ekibi ekyamala okukolebwa, oba okuziba olukonko ekibi kyaffe lwe kyasima. Gano ge mawulire amabi agafuula amawulire amalungi ag’omuwendo — awatali go, omusaalaba gwandibadde kibonoobono so si kununulibwa.

Omutima gw’ensonga: Katonda kye yakola ku musaalaba

Wano amawulire amalungi we gayingirira. Mu kifo ky’okutuleka okwesasulira ebbanja lyaffe, Katonda yalisasula yekka. “Katonda alaga okwagala kwe gye tuli mu ngeri eno: bwe twali tukyali boonoonyi, Kristo n’atufiirira.” (Abaruumi 5:8). Si nga tumaze okwerongoosa — bwe twali tukyali boonoonyi. Ku musaalaba, Yesu, Omwana wa Katonda atalina kibi, yatwala ekifo ky’abazzi b’emisango. Pawulo annyonnyola enkyukakyuka eyo ennene: “Kubanga oyo ataamanya kibi, yafuuka ekibi ku lwaffe, tulyoke tufune obutuukirivu obuva eri Katonda mu Yesu.” (2 Abakkolinso 5:21). Ekibi kyaffe kyateekebwa ku Kristo; obutuukirivu bwe obutuukiridde ne bubalibwa ku ffe. Yafuna ekyo kye twali tusaanidde, ffe tulyoke tufune ekyo kye tutandisobodde kwekolera.

Kino kye kikyukiro ky’obubaka bwonna, era kisaana okukirwako, kubanga kiddamu ekibuuzo buli mutima ogw’amazima kye gubuuza ku nkomerero: Katonda ow’obwenkanya ayinza atya okubuusa obubuusa amaaso ekibi? Eky’okuddamu kiri nti takibuusa maaso — akisasulira yekka. Ku musaalaba, obwenkanya bwa Katonda n’okusaasira kwe bisisinkana: ekibonerezo ekibi kyaffe kye kyali kisaanyiza kyatuukirizibwa kyonna, naye ku Oyo eyeewaayo okutuyimirira mu kifo kyaffe, Katonda alyoke abeere ow’obwenkanya era nga y’oyo awa obutuukirivu buli akkiriza Yesu: “Kino kiraga Katonda bw’alaga okwaniriza kw’alina eri abantu mu biro bino, bwe baba n’okukkiriza mu Yesu.” (Abaruumi 3:26). Tewali kyakwekebwa wansi w’omukeeka; buli kimu kyasasulibwa kyonna. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki Omukristaayo ayinza okuba n’emirembe egya ddala ne Katonda, so si essuubi ery’okweraliikirira nti oboolyawo ku nkomerero ebbanja linaggwaawo. Ebbanja lyamala okusasulwa.

Charles Spurgeon yabuulira obulamu bwe bwonna ku mulamwa guno gumu — “Kristo eyakomererwa” — era mu Byonna Bya Kisa yeegayirira omwonoonyi eyeeraliikirira alekere awo okugezaako okwerokola, wabula yeesige busizi ekyo Kristo ky’amaze okukola. Entaana enkalu ekissaako akabonero: kubanga Yesu yaziikibwa “n’azuukizibwa ku lunaku olwokusatu,” okufa kwe tekwali kuwangulwa wabula buwanguzi — lisiiti ya Katonda mu lwatu nti ebbanja ddala lisasuddwa era nti okufa kwennyini kuwanguddwa.

Lwaki nkulu: enjiri ky’ekuwa

Kino si njigiriza bunjigiriza ey’okukkiriziganya nayo; kikyusa buli kimu ku kifo omuntu ky’alina mu maaso ga Katonda. Eri bonna abagisembeza, enjiri ebawa:

  • Okusonyiyibwa — okusonyiyibwa okujjuvu era okw’obwereere okw’ebibi byonna, eby’emabega, ebya kaakano n’eby’omu maaso, nga byasasulirwa ddala ku musaalaba.
  • Enkolagana empya — nga tetukyali bajeemu oba bagwira, wabula abaana ba Katonda, abaanirizibwa mu maka ge.
  • Obulamu obutaggwaawo — “ekirabo kya Katonda, bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.” (Abaruumi 6:23). Si kubeerawo bubeerawo okutaliiko nkomerero, wabula obulamu ne Katonda okufa bwe kutayinza kukomya.
  • Amaanyi okukyuka — enjiri “ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza” (Abaruumi 1:16); tetusonyiwa busonyiyi, wabula etuzza buggya.

Kisa, so si bye tutuukako

Ekisinga obukulu okutegeera kiri nti bino byonna kirabo. Twamanyiira nnyo okukolera buli kintu, ne kiba nti mu butonde tugezaako okusasulira obulokozi n’ebikolwa ebirungi. Naye enjiri eggalawo oluggi olwo: “Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw’okukkiriza. Tekwava mu mmwe, wabula kirabo kya Katonda. Tekwatuweebwa lwa bikolwa byaffe; noolwekyo omuntu yenna aleme okwenyumirizanga.” (Abaefeso 2:8-9). Tosobola kugula ekyo ekyamala okukugulirwa; osobola kukisembeza bukisembeza. Ekyo kye kigifuula amawulire amalungi so si magezi malungi gokka — amagezi gakugamba ky’oteekwa okukola; amawulire gakugamba ekimaze okukolebwa.

Era kwe kununulibwa kwokka okuliwo: “Tewali mu mulala yenna bulokozi, era tewali linnya ddala na limu mu mannya gonna agaaweebwa abantu, wansi w’eggulu, mwetugwanira okulokolebwa.” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 4:12).

Engeri y’okugyanukula

Obanga enjiri kirango ky’ekyo Katonda ky’akoze, okugyanukula si kwe kufuba okusingawo, wabula kwe kwesiga — okukyuka ng’olekayo okufuga obulamu bwo ku bubwo, n’owummulira mu Kristo. Oboolyawo olunyiriri olusinga okumanyika mu nsi lukyogera lwonna: “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.” (Yokaana 3:16). Okukkiriza kwe kulekera awo okwesiga ggwe kennyini n’otandika okwesiga ye — okusembeza okusonyiyibwa kwe yagula ng’ekirabo eky’obwereere bwe kiri. Okwenenya n’okukkiriza ze njuyi ebbiri ez’okukyuka okwo: okwenenya kwe kukyuka okuva mu kufuga obulamu bwo ku bubwo, n’okukkiriza kwe kukyukira eri Kristo abufuge mu kifo kyo. Tewali na kimu ku byo kikolwa ekikolera kintu kyonna; byombi tebiri birala wabula emikono ebyereere egisembeza ekirabo ekyamala okugulibwa.

Okugyanukula okwo kuyinza okuba okwangu ng’okusaba okw’amazima: okwatula nti oli mwonoonyi atasobola kwerokola, okukkiriza nti Yesu yakufiirira era n’azuukira ku lulwo, n’okumusaba abeere Omulokozi wo era Mukama wo. Omubbi eyali afa yakikola mu sentensi emu, n’awulira Yesu ng’agamba nti, “olwa leero ojja kubeera nange mu Lusuku lwa Katonda.” Enjiri si mpeera ya bantu abalina obulamu obutegeke obulungi. Bwe bununuzi bw’abo abamanyi nti tebasobola kwerokola — era abo ffenna. Eyo y’ensonga lwaki ge mawulire amalungi bwe gatyo.

Enjiri ky’etali

Olw’okuba ekigambo kino kikozesebwa nga tekyegenderezeddwa, kiyamba okuggyawo okutabulwa okumu okumanyiddwa. Enjiri si “beera muntu mulungi, Katonda anaakusembeza” — ekyo kye kikontana ddala n’ekisa, era kikuleka ng’otamanya oba ng’okoze ekimala. Si “Katonda akwagala era alina enteekateeka ennungi ku bulamu bwo” bwokka, awatali musaalaba, omuwendo okwagala okwo gwe kwasasula. Si mateeka, si nteekateeka ya byabufuzi, era si nkola ya kwerongoosa. Era si bubaka nti oteekwa okusooka okwerongoosa olwo n’olyoka ojja eri Katonda. Buli kimu ku ebyo kifuula obulokozi ekintu ky’otuukako ku lulwo; enjiri ebufuula ekintu ky’osembeza.

Eno y’ensonga ddala lwaki erina amaanyi bwe gatyo okubudaabuda abalina omusango n’abakooye. Eddiini ey’okwetuusaako esobola kukugamba kimu kyokka: fuba nnyo okusingawo — era omutima ogw’amazima gumanyi nti okufuba okusingawo tekumalanga. Enjiri ekola ekyo eddiini yonna ky’etasobola: erangirira nti omulimu guwedde. Yesu bwe yali ku musaalaba yaleekaana nti “Kiwedde” — si “genda okole,” wabula “kimaze okukolebwa.” Eyo ye njawulo wakati w’enjiri n’ebirala byonna ebyeyita amawulire amalungi, era ye njawulo wakati w’okukkiriza okukukooya n’okukkiriza okukuwa ekiwummulo ku nkomerero.

qa.question: Enjiri ye ki mu sentensi emu?
qa.answer: Pawulo y’awa ennyinnyonnyola esinga okutegeerekeka: “Kristo yafa olw’ebibi byaffe, ng’Ebyawandiikibwa bwe bigamba, era nti yaziikibwa, n’azuukizibwa ku lunaku olwokusatu” (1 Abakkolinso 15:3-4). qa.question: Enjiri eyawukana etya ku ddiini?
qa.answer: Eddiini ekukwasa amadaala n’ekugamba nti linnya; enjiri erangirira nti Katonda yakka wansi. Buli nkola endala egamba nti “kola”: kuuma amateeka gano, olwo oboolyawo Katonda anaakusembeza. Enjiri egamba nti “kiwedde”: ekyo ky’otosobolanga kukola kyakukolerwa, era ekisigaddewo kyokka kwe kukisembeza.

qa.question: Katonda ow’obwenkanya ayinza atya okusonyiwa ekibi?
qa.answer: Takibuusa maaso; akisasulira yekka. Ku musaalaba Omwana atalina kibi yatwala ekifo ky’abazzi b’emisango, ekibonerezo ekibi kye kyali kisaanyiza ne kituukirizibwa kyonna ku Oyo eyeewaayo okutuyimirira mu kifo kyaffe. Bwe kityo Katonda wa bwenkanya era y’awa obutuukirivu oyo akkiriza Yesu: “Kino kiraga Katonda bw’alaga okwaniriza kw’alina eri abantu mu biro bino, bwe baba n’okukkiriza mu Yesu.” (Abaruumi 3:26). Ebbanja lyamala okusasulwa.

qa.question: Enjiri ewa omuntu ki?
qa.answer: Okusonyiyibwa okujjuvu era okw’obwereere okw’ebibi byonna; enkolagana empya ng’omwana wa Katonda mu kifo ky’omujeemu oba omugwira; obulamu obutaggwaawo, kubanga “ekirabo kya Katonda, bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.” (Abaruumi 6:23); n’amaanyi okukyuka, kubanga enjiri “ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza” (Abaruumi 1:16).

qa.question: Omuntu asaanidde kwanukula atya enjiri?
qa.answer: Si mu kufuba okusingawo, wabula mu kwesiga. Okwenenya kwe kukyuka ng’olekayo okufuga obulamu bwo ku bubwo, n’okukkiriza kwe kukyukira eri Kristo abufuge mu kifo kyo; tewali na kimu ku byo kikolera kintu kyonna. Kiyinza okuba okwangu ng’okusaba okw’amazima: okwatula nti tosobola kwerokola, okukkiriza nti Yesu yakufiirira era n’azuukira ku lulwo, n’okumusaba abeere Omulokozi wo era Mukama wo.

qa.answer: Si “beera muntu mulungi, Katonda anaakusembeza,” ekyo ekikontana n’ekisa. Si “Katonda akwagala” awatali musaalaba, omuwendo okwagala okwo gwe kwasasula, era si mateeka, nteekateeka ya byabufuzi oba nkola ya kwerongoosa.
